name: Timezone Offset Harmonizer API
shortDescription: Deterministic timezone conversion and UTC normalization from absolute instants for agents
description: Agent-native timezone math backed by the IANA/ICU database. /normalize converts any absolute instant (ISO 8601 with Z/offset, or epoch ms) to UTC and epoch. /convert expresses that instant as wall-clock time, UTC offset, and zone abbreviation (DST-correct, e.g. PST vs PDT) in a target timezone. The one-call /lookup harmonizes one instant across up to 25 zones for meeting scheduling, with a reasoning object. Naive local times are rejected to guarantee correctness — never guessed, confidence always 1.0.
